requirements.quote: Inspect `/home/user/ci_cd_poc/pipelines.db` and confirm that the table “builds” exists. (Do NOT drop or recreate it.)

check.cmd: [ "$(sqlite3 /home/user/ci_cd_poc/pipelines.db "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='builds';")" = 1 ]

requirements.quote: Inside the same database, create a new table named “deployments” with EXACTLY the following columns and types in the given order

check.cmd: [ "$(sqlite3 /home/user/ci_cd_poc/pipelines.db "SELECT group_concat(name||':'||upper(type)||':'||pk, ',') FROM (SELECT * FROM pragma_table_info('deployments') ORDER BY cid);")" = 'id:INTEGER:1,build_id:INTEGER:0,env:TEXT:0,deployed_at:TEXT:0,status:TEXT:0' ]

requirements.quote: Create a directory `/home/user/ci_cd_poc/audit` (if it does not already exist) and inside it write the file `/home/user/ci_cd_poc/audit/deployment_audit.log` in the EXACT format shown below.
The first line **must** be exactly “AUDIT START: 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z”. Do NOT substitute the current date; use the fixed timestamp.
The last line **must** be “AUDIT END” with no trailing spaces.
There is one completely blank line between each major block (see the template above).

check.cmd: [ "$(grep -c '^$' /home/user/ci_cd_poc/audit/deployment_audit.log)" = 3 ] && [ "$(sed -n 2p /home/user/ci_cd_poc/audit/deployment_audit.log)" = '' ] && [ "$(sed -n 3p /home/user/ci_cd_poc/audit/deployment_audit.log)" = 'BUILDS:' ] && grep -B1 -x 'DEPLOYMENTS:' /home/user/ci_cd_poc/audit/deployment_audit.log | head -n 1 | grep -qx '' && grep -B1 -x 'AUDIT END' /home/user/ci_cd_poc/audit/deployment_audit.log | head -n 1 | grep -qx ''

requirements.quote: Do not add extra columns, reorder columns, or change column names.
CSV rows are plain text, comma-separated, with no surrounding quotes.

check.cmd:
diff <(printf 'AUDIT START: 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z

BUILDS:
id,status,started_at
'; sqlite3 -list -separator , /home/user/ci_cd_poc/pipelines.db 'SELECT id,status,started_at FROM builds ORDER BY id;'; printf '
DEPLOYMENTS:
id,build_id,env,deployed_at,status
'; sqlite3 -list -separator , /home/user/ci_cd_poc/pipelines.db 'SELECT id,build_id,env,deployed_at,status FROM deployments ORDER BY id;'; printf '
AUDIT END
') <(sed '$a' /home/user/ci_cd_poc/audit/deployment_audit.log)
